与中转服务共享的推送令牌，用于鉴权。请填写你在中转侧配置的值。

选择通知标题包含哪些字段。

Agent.Script:
#!/bin/bash ############ {0} ############
############ # WeComHub notification agent (configuration half). # # This file holds ONLY your configuration. The implementation lives in # /usr/local/emhttp/plugins/WeComHub/wecom-hub-notify-agent.sh # and is updated together with the plugin. Because this file is not managed by # the plugin, your settings survive plugin upgrades. # # Edit the variables through: # Settings -> Notification -> Notification Agents -> WeComHub # Do not edit the block above by hand; the page regenerates it on Apply. ############
AGENT="/usr/local/emhttp/plugins/WeComHub/wecom-hub-notify-agent.sh" if [[ -x "$AGENT" ]]; then exec "$AGENT" fi
# Plugin body missing: record it instead of failing silently. echo "$(date) plugin body not found: $AGENT" >>/var/log/notify_WeComHub exit 0
